physics-killer-06.title: Ọgbaghara na nchekwa, mmepụta kwụ ọtọ na ike ndọda
physics-killer-06.topic: Ọgbaghara na nchekwa, mmepụta kwụ ọtọ na ike ndọda
physics-killer-06.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-06.material: N'elu larịị na-enweghị esemokwu, ihe A dị $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ na-aga n'ọsọ $6\,\mathrm{m/s}$ kụrụ ihe B dị $4\,\mathrm{kg}$ nke na-ezu ike, wee ihe abụọ ahụ jikọta ma na-agagharị ọnụ. Ọ bụrụ na oge mgbagwoju anya bụ $0.05\,\mathrm{s}$, kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, ọsọ ihe abụọ ozugbo mgbe mgbagwoju anya, na ịdị ukwuu ike nkezi B nwetara n'oge mgbagwoju anya?
physics-killer-06.thinking.0: Ọgbaghara na nchekwa, mmepụta kwụ ọtọ na ike ndọda
physics-killer-06.s.s1.prompt: N'elu larịị na-enweghị esemokwu, ihe A dị $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ na-aga n'ọsọ $6\,\mathrm{m/s}$ kụrụ ihe B dị $4\,\mathrm{kg}$ nke na-ezu ike, wee ihe abụọ ahụ jikọta ma na-agagharị ọnụ. Ọ bụrụ na oge mgbagwoju anya bụ $0.05\,\mathrm{s}$, kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, ọsọ ihe abụọ ozugbo mgbe mgbagwoju anya, na ịdị ukwuu ike nkezi B nwetara n'oge mgbagwoju anya?
physics-killer-06.s.s1.explain: Nchekwa momentum: $2\cdot6=(2+4)v\Rightarrow v=2\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Mgbanwe momentum nke B $\Delta p_B=4\cdot2-0=8\,\mathrm{kg\cdot m/s}$, yabụ $F_{avg}=\dfrac{8}{0.05}=160\,\mathrm{N}$. (Mgbanwe momentum nke A $2(2-6)=-8$ nwere otu ịdị ukwuu, yabụ nsonaazụ kwekọrọ.) Ọ bụrụ na e jiri $m_A$ naanị kama ibu jikọtara, $v=3\,\mathrm{m/s}$, azịza na-ezighị ezi ①; ọ bụrụ na e jiri momentum mbụ nke A $12$ n'ọgbakọ ike, $240\,\mathrm{N}$ (azịza na-ezighị ezi ②); ọ bụrụ na e tinye $v_B=4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ nke mgbagwoju anya elastic, azịza na-ezighị ezi ③.
